title: Vibrant Crunchy American Beef Skillet
description: A winey and crunchy American dish featuring sweet smoked paprika, perfect for a low-glycemic diet, served in a bento-box. This adventurous recipe is a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sweet smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the red wine and stir to deglaze the skillet, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot in a bento-box, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
